scientific limitations/integrity: The result corrects only the explicit construction \(n=M+k-1\) in arXiv:2609.25042v1. It does not resolve whether infinitely many good deficiency-one binomial coefficients exist. The 1993 source was checked through bibliographic records and secondary summaries rather than full text; the accepted valuation theorem is self-contained and was compared directly with the complete arXiv v1 text.
title: Exact small-prime valuations in the proposed deficiency-one construction
